Do you like Pokémon?\c

COPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But that’s my favorite hobby!

You must like Pokémon.\c

I asked you.\c

You’re weird!\c
COPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But that’s my favorite hobby!
COPYCAT: Oh, it’s you! Are you here to let me\nmimic you again?
COPYCAT: Oh, hey! Do you want me to mimic\nyou again?
You have a Clefairy with you.\nDo you want to show it to Copycat?

Oh wow! A real-life Clefairy!
I’ve never seen one before!\c
Thank you so much!
You know what? I’ll give you a TM that lets your
Pokémon create a copy of itself!
TM08 contains the move Substitute!\c\nIt lets your Pokémon create a decoy of itself\nby spending HP!

[VAR RIVALNAME(0000)]: Hi!
